exact_statement:
theorem anderson_spectrum_ae {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) :
    ∀ᵐ v ∂disorderLaw h, ∃ H : Hilbert →L[ℂ] Hilbert,
      IsAndersonOperator v H ∧ IsSelfAdjoint H ∧ spectrum ℂ H = spectralInterval h
